Market today:
The S&P 500 just saw its first July decline since 2014, signaling a cautious market mood. This broad selloff, likely impacting tech, is the real driver. AI remains a hot topic with Databricks pre-IPO buzz and regulatory deadlines, but the overall market is pulling back.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-54.92%) and SPAL (-60.95%) are bleeding heavily. Both are leveraged ETFs with default stops far above current prices, needing immediate attention. QQQ (-3.73%) and SMH (-15.06%) are on TRIM status and very close to their stops. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on the broader market's reaction to the S&P 500's July decline. Also, monitor any developments in AI regulation, as this could impact your tech/chip heavy book.

Bottom line:
Focus on managing risk and protecting capital, especially with your leveraged positions and margin exposure.
plays: SOXL: Your stop at 200 is ineffective. Given the -54.92% loss and leveraged nature, re-evaluate your position and set a realistic stop or consider trimming.
SPAL: Your stop at 21.38 is ineffective. With a -60.95% loss and leveraged nature, reassess your position and set a realistic stop or consider trimming.
SMH: Price is at 540.53, stop is 540. Respect your stop and trim if it breaks.
